description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing RAN resources in a 5G DU, including resource updating, configuration, and deallocation for UEs, with specific focus on resource managers and UE resource configuration.

classes.name: du_ue_ran_resource_updater_impl
classes.description: Implements resource updating for a UE's RAN resources, allowing configuration updates and retrieval.

classes.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl
classes.description: Manages RAN resources for multiple UEs, including creation, update, deallocation, and configuration management.

methods.name: create_ue_resource_configurator
methods.description: Creates a resource configurator for a specific UE.

methods.name: update_context
methods.description: Updates a UE's cell configuration context based on F1 UE Context Update request.

methods.name: deallocate_context
methods.description: Deallocates RAN resources for a UE.

methods.name: ue_config_applied
methods.description: Marks that the UE's configuration has been successfully applied.
